settings.title: Agent
settings.description: Manage models, execution environments and permissions. Choose a section to configure.

feature.title: Agent feature
feature.description: Controls whether the Agent Host accepts and schedules new execution work. Historical data and maintenance remain available when disabled.
feature.enableFailed: The Agent runtime is not ready. Check the App health and try again
feature.disableFailed: The Agent did not fully disable. Refresh the state and try again

onboarding.title: Enable Agent with Nexus Agent
onboarding.description: Nexus will install the official Nexus Agent plugin from the signed first-party catalog, grant its declared capabilities, and enable it as the default Agent app. The plugin contains the signed Operations and Developer Skills and remains independently installable and upgradable after this step.
onboarding.subtitle: Set up the signed first-party agent runtime and core capabilities
onboarding.featureSkillsDesc: Includes signed Operations and Developer skills for operations and coding
onboarding.featureSandboxDesc: Strictly bounded by host policy, approvals, and workspace boundaries
onboarding.featureDecoupledDesc: Independently upgradable or removable without mutating core images
onboarding.installStep1: Downloading and verifying Ed25519 signature & integrity...
onboarding.installStep2: Registering and loading Operations & Developer skills...
onboarding.installStep3: Initializing sandbox policy and enabling Agent instance...
onboarding.sandboxProtected: Runtime guarded by Host sandbox security policies
onboarding.defaultPluginSummary: Official general-purpose agent engine with verified operations and developer skills running inside secure sandbox boundaries.

apps.title: Agent apps
apps.description: Enable or disable each Agent app independently. Disabling one app does not stop other apps.
apps.permissionsHint: Only manifest-declared capabilities can be granted. Changes take effect only after you save them.
apps.noCapabilities: This app does not declare any grantable capabilities.
apps.permissionsCollapsedHint: Expand to review and edit this app’s capability grants.
apps.capabilitiesSubtitle: Fine-grained capability boundary control governed by host security policies
apps.uninstallConfirmPrompt: Are you sure you want to uninstall {name} (v{version})? This will remove its package code and drain background tasks.
apps.deleteDataFailed: The app was uninstalled, but retained data could not be deleted
apps.coreAppCannotUninstall: Core builtin app cannot be uninstalled

plugins.title: Installable apps and skills
plugins.description: Trust publisher keys explicitly, verify signed packages, and manage installed Agent apps. Package code is immutable; app data is kept separately.
plugins.publisherHint: Import an Ed25519 public key only after you have verified its fingerprint with the publisher.
plugins.noPublishers: No publisher keys have been trusted.
plugins.packageHint: The package is uploaded as an Artifact, then checked for signature, hashes, unsafe archive entries, manifest compatibility, and size limits before installation.
plugins.noCandidate: Choose a .tar package to verify it before installation.
plugins.noneInstalled: No installable plugins are currently installed.
plugins.retainedDataHint: Uninstalling code does not delete AppStorage. Data deletion is a separate destructive action.
plugins.deleteDataWarning: This permanently deletes the retained AppStorage for this app. Plugin code is already uninstalled and this data cannot be recovered from Nexus after deletion.

notices.pluginInstalled: Plugin installed. It starts disabled with no grants.
notices.pluginDraining: New Runs are paused while existing Runs finish. Continue the operation after they drain.
notices.pluginUninstalledDataRetained: Plugin code uninstalled. App data was retained.

plugins.remoteRepositoriesHint: The Nexus first-party catalog is pinned by the Host. Additional repositories provide discovery only and require an explicitly trusted Ed25519 publisher before installation.

hardLimits.title: Hard Limits
hardLimits.description: Instance policy ceilings. Every change requires preview and explicit confirmation.
hardLimits.panelHint: Instance Hard Limits · changes require confirmation
hardLimits.confirmDescription: Review {count} changes. {runtimes} runtimes are currently executing.
hardLimits.presetsHint: Select instance-level hard limit presets to balance concurrency safety and system stability.
hardLimits.presetStandardDesc: Suitable for everyday development and regular concurrency, preventing resource exhaustion
hardLimits.presetHighDesc: Increases concurrency and storage limits for heavy workloads or automated runs
hardLimits.presetCustomDesc: Fine-tune each instance-level hard constraint individually

groups.timeoutsDesc: Limits maximum task duration and individual tool execution timeouts
groups.storageDesc: Limits artifact disk usage and tool/recall data payload volumes
groups.concurrencyDesc: Limits concurrent runs, active workspaces, and subagent delegation depth
groups.executionDesc: Caps the maximum number of model/tool loop steps per Run

maxRunSteps.label: Hard Max Run Steps
maxRunSteps.hint: Maximum thinking and tool execution loop steps allowed per run

maxActiveExecutionSeconds.label: Max Active Execution Time
maxActiveExecutionSeconds.hint: Maximum continuous execution duration before auto-cancellation

toolTimeoutSeconds.label: Tool Execution Timeout
toolTimeoutSeconds.hint: Maximum seconds allowed for a single tool call (Shell, Web, etc.)

unretainedArtifactTtlSeconds.label: Unretained Artifact TTL
unretainedArtifactTtlSeconds.hint: Retention duration for temporary unarchived artifacts

maxToolOutputBytes.label: Max Tool Output Size
maxToolOutputBytes.hint: Maximum payload bytes returned by a single tool execution

maxArtifactBytes.label: Run Artifact Disk Quota
maxArtifactBytes.hint: Total disk space quota for artifacts within a single run

maxSingleArtifactBytes.label: Max Single Artifact Size
maxSingleArtifactBytes.hint: Maximum file size allowed for an individual artifact

maxGlobalArtifactBytes.label: Global Artifact Disk Quota
maxGlobalArtifactBytes.hint: System-wide disk quota for all agent artifacts combined

maxRecallItems.label: Max Recall Items
maxRecallItems.hint: Maximum number of history/memory items retrieved per request

maxRecallBytes.label: Max Recall Payload Size
maxRecallBytes.hint: Maximum byte payload for retrieved memory items

maxConcurrentRuntimes.label: Max Agent execution concurrency
maxConcurrentRuntimes.hint: Maximum total Root Agent and Subagent Runtimes executing concurrently for one user; both share the same slots

maxConcurrentModelCalls.label: Max model request concurrency
maxConcurrentModelCalls.hint: Maximum concurrent model API requests for one user; it can never exceed Agent execution concurrency

maxDelegationDepth.label: Max Subagent Depth
maxDelegationDepth.hint: Maximum nested recursion depth for subagent delegation

maxSubagentMessagesPerRun.label: Max Subagent Messages
maxSubagentMessagesPerRun.hint: Maximum subagent interaction messages allowed per run

maxSubagentMessageBytesPerRun.label: Max Subagent Message Bytes
maxSubagentMessageBytesPerRun.hint: Total byte ceiling for subagent message exchanges in a run

maxActiveWorkspaces.label: Max Active Workspaces
maxActiveWorkspaces.hint: Maximum number of concurrent workspace containers or directories

performance.title: Execution and performance
performance.description: Controls Agent work and model requests that may execute at the same time. Lower values only affect future scheduling and do not interrupt work already running.
performance.runtimesHint: Total Agent units executing concurrently for one user; the Root Agent and every Subagent each occupy one slot
performance.modelCallsHint: Concurrent model API requests; Auto follows Agent execution concurrency, and an explicit value can never exceed it

budget.title: Budget and context
budget.description: Configure total Run and tool-resource budgets. Per-call model context and output capabilities come from the Model Registry.
budget.presetsHint: Select a scenario preset to apply recommended values, or customize parameters freely.
budget.presetLightDesc: Quick responses and minimal resource usage, great for quick queries and single-step fixes
budget.presetBalancedDesc: Recommended defaults balancing reasoning depth, multi-step actions, and resources
budget.presetDeepDesc: High steps and long timeouts, best for complex refactoring and large codebases
budget.presetCustomDesc: Manually tune all underlying parameters with complete control

fields.maxRunStepsHint: Maximum tool actions and reasoning turns per run
fields.maxToolOutputBytesHint: Maximum output bytes returned to model
fields.maxRecallItemsHint: Maximum relevant memory snippets to recall
fields.maxRecallBytesHint: Maximum total bytes for recalled memories

budget.readyNotice: The current configuration is ready and will apply to the next Run.
budget.modelCapabilityNotice: Per-call context and output limits come directly from the Provider/Registry model capabilities. These settings only govern total Run and tool-resource budgets.

quantity.invalidQuantity: Invalid format; use a number with an optional unit

storage.title: Artifacts and storage
storage.description: Configure requested Artifact quotas and review current storage usage.
storage.hardLimitHint: Requested storage values remain bounded by the corresponding Hard Limits.
storage.inputHelp: Enter a number directly or use unit shortcuts (e.g. 10M, 500K, 2G, 1d)

workspaceRuntime.title: Workspace dev environment
workspaceRuntime.description: Manage the Agent Runner, Workspace profiles, shared multi-version Tool Packs, storage, and runtime cleanup.
workspaceRuntime.selectRecipe: Select at least one Workspace profile.
workspaceRuntime.setupDescription: Enable the Workspace dev profile and prepare its exact Tool Packs. Enabled and installed are tracked separately.
workspaceRuntime.resetImpact: This restores Workspace profile and tool-version preferences to release defaults. Artifacts and Providers are not changed.
workspaceRuntime.resetComplete: Workspace Runtime settings restored to defaults.
workspaceRuntime.uninstallImpact: Releases about {bytes}. In use: {inUse}. Replacement default: {replacement}.

safety.title: Globally blocked targets
safety.description: Configure Host-level hard blocks for Agents here. The SSH picker below chat only chooses hosts for a specific Run.
safety.guardrails: A globally blocked target is denied by the Host even if it is selected in the chat SSH picker.
safety.emptyConnections: No connection targets configured. Please add connections in Connection Management first.
safety.connectionLoadFailed: Failed to load the connection list. Please try again.
safety.reasonPlaceholder: Enter the reason for updating this safety policy (e.g. Production isolation, Audit compliance)
safety.emptyConnectionsDetail: No host or device connections are configured, so Agents cannot reach private machines by default.
safety.scopeHint: This is a global hard restriction across conversations and Runs, not the SSH selection for the current chat.

providers.title: Model providers
providers.name: Display name
providers.defaultModelHint: This initializes the model picker for a new Run. Each started Run still freezes its own model snapshot.
providers.discoveryHint: Missing capabilities open the editor before the model is added.
providers.deleteProviderConfirmPrompt: Are you sure you want to delete provider {name}? This cannot be undone.
providers.atLeastOneModel: At least one model must be retained
providers.cannotRemoveDefault: Default model cannot be removed directly; switch default model first
providers.allModelsConfigured: All supported models have been added
providers.testModalDesc: Test connections or adjust model capabilities.
providers.autoSaveHint: Changes are saved automatically for the next Run.
providers.emptyHint: Use Add Provider to connect OpenAI, DeepSeek, Moonshot, or a local Ollama service.
providers.capabilityDescription: Provider/registry capabilities are applied automatically and can be overridden here.
providers.capabilityInvalid: Invalid model capabilities: max output must be smaller than the context window.
providers.capabilityUnavailable: This model has incomplete capability metadata.
providers.capabilityNeedsReview: {count} models need capability details; add them individually.
providers.reasoningSelectOne: Select at least one reasoning effort when reasoning is enabled.
providers.capabilityConflict: Capability sources conflict: {fields}. Custom overrides Provider, then Registry.

guardrails.title: System guardrails
guardrails.description: Read-only protocol and persistence safety limits. These are not ordinary user settings.

subagents.title: Subagents
subagents.description: Run-scoped delegation limits for child agents, durable mailbox traffic, and shared collaboration budgets.
subagents.concurrencyHint: Subagents do not have a separate concurrency count. Root Agents and all Subagents share the Agent execution concurrency above; this section controls delegation depth and collaboration-message budgets.
subagents.templateHint: Templates are provider-neutral presets. Copying one creates a normal App profile using the current default model; edit it before saving if needed.
subagents.profileHint: Profiles freeze their model and capability ceiling when a child is created. Current App grants and the parent grant are checked again at execution time.
subagents.peerSameRun: Any authorized peer in the same Run
subagents.mutationHint: Governed mutation profiles expose only Workspace mutation tools, and only on Runs using Full Access. Each worker must use a Workspace owned by its child runtime; approval, lease/fence, verification, evidence, and reconciliation remain enforced.
subagents.noProfiles: No Subagent profiles are configured for this App.

browserRuntime.title: Browser Runtime
browserRuntime.description: Configure CDP targets used by the single Backend BrowserRuntime. Endpoint network scope and reachability path are independent; via=runner uses Runner only as a network tunnel.
browserRuntime.empty: No browser targets configured. External CDP reachable by Backend can work without Runner using via=backend.
browserRuntime.allowedUrls: Allowed page URL patterns (one per line)
browserRuntime.endpointHint: scope describes where the endpoint lives; via selects direct Backend access or a Runner tunnel. v1 rejects credentials in URL userinfo, query, or fragment.

mcpIntegrations.title: MCP Integrations
mcpIntegrations.description: Manage external MCP endpoints exposed to Nexus Agent. Enabled means configured; Ready means the current generation has refreshed successfully and is published to the Tool catalog.
mcpIntegrations.installAgentFirst: Install the Nexus Agent plugin before managing MCP integrations.
mcpIntegrations.confirmDelete: Delete MCP integration "{name}"? Its saved credential and published Tool contribution will be removed.

acpRuntime.title: ACP Runtime
acpRuntime.description: Configure ACP process profiles that may run inside Workspaces and ACP integrations exposed to Nexus Agent. ACP processes are bound to the frozen Workspace generation/runtime profile; the single-user native Runner does not claim per-process read-only or network sandboxing.
acpRuntime.profilesHint: argv is a JSON string array; cwd must be under /workspace. Saved profiles can be selected and frozen when a Workspace generation is created.
acpRuntime.integrationsHint: An integration is the Agent-facing logical entry and references a saved Workspace profile. Execution still requires a running Workspace containing that profile.
acpRuntime.saveProfileFirst: Save at least one ACP profile before creating an integration.
acpRuntime.installAgentFirst: Install the Nexus Agent plugin before managing ACP integrations. Workspace ACP profiles can still be configured in advance.

groupDescriptions.overview: Feature state, installed Agent apps, app activity, and capability grants.
groupDescriptions.models: Default model, providers, context budgets, and instance ceilings.
groupDescriptions.execution: Concurrency, performance, and Subagent profiles for delegated work.
groupDescriptions.environments: Workspace Runner, browser targets, and ACP process integrations.
groupDescriptions.storage: Artifact quotas, retention, and current storage pressure.
groupDescriptions.extensions: Signed Agent apps, plugin repositories, packages, and publisher trust.
groupDescriptions.safety: Target deny rules and read-only system guardrails.

executionPolicy.title: Plugin / App execution budget
executionPolicy.description: Each Agent Plugin/App can override global Run, tool, and collaboration budgets and choose a model-aware Normal/Extended context policy. Unset fields inherit global defaults.
executionPolicy.compactionHint: Old history starts compacting at the frozen soft-pressure threshold. The hard boundary still derives from the current model window and reserved output.
executionPolicy.profileHint: Normal keeps more context headroom; Extended uses more of the model window. Neither profile relaxes Hard Limits.

memory.title: Memory review & publishing
memory.description: Review durable App memories before they enter Recall, revoke published items, and import published Memory across Apps.
memory.empty: No Memory items match this App and status.
memory.conflict: This Memory changed elsewhere. The authoritative version has been reloaded.
memory.importDescription: Choose a live published Memory from another App, preview its frozen confirmation, then import it.
memory.noPublishedSource: This source App has no live published Memory available.

hub.title: Agent
hub.appUnavailable: This Agent app does not have a local presentation.
hub.noSurface: This Agent App does not provide an interactive surface.

pluginFrontend.unavailable: This plugin UI is unavailable or could not establish an isolated host bridge.

operations.confirmDeleteThread: Click again to delete this conversation
operations.deleteThreadActiveHint: Stop the active Run before deleting this conversation.
operations.confirmDeleteAllThreads: Click again to delete all conversations
operations.deleteAllThreadsActiveHint: Stop all active Runs before deleting all conversations.
operations.reconciliationRequired: A previous mutation or its resource/lease finalization still requires reconciliation. Verify the actual state before releasing the resource quarantine.
operations.restartRecoveryFailed: Automatic recovery after the backend restart could not continue from its checkpoint: {reasons}
operations.reconciliationLeaseFinalization: The mutation outcome was already confirmed. Only the lease/resource finalization became uncertain; verify the resource state and release quarantine without retrying the mutation.
operations.reconciliationNotePlaceholder: Describe what you verified, for example: no remote change occurred / the change completed and the resulting state is healthy
operations.reconciliationHint: Confirming only releases quarantine; it does not retry the original mutation.
operations.runModelLocked: The model is frozen while the current Run is active.
operations.executionModeHint: Choose whether the next Run may execute changes or is limited to read/control planning tools
operations.executionExecuteDesc: Run normally with the selected approval mode governing mutations.
operations.executionPlanDesc: Expose only read/control tools to the model. Mutations are not available; submit a later Execute Run to carry out the plan.
operations.approvalModeHint: Choose how the next Run handles write or destructive operations that require confirmation
operations.approvalFullAccessDesc: Automatically approve in-scope mutations while keeping capability checks, deny rules, and approval audit records.
operations.approvalAskDesc: Pause on operations that require confirmation and ask you directly in the conversation.
operations.threadZoomHint: Ctrl/⌘ + wheel resizes the conversation list; wheel alone scrolls
operations.environmentDefaultsHint: The selection is validated against the current Runner catalog and Agent settings when the Run is created, then frozen into its Run definition.
operations.environmentRunContract: Workspace creation consumes this Run's frozen Environment snapshot; recipe and toolchain choices cannot change mid-Run.

files.cleanupPreview: Delete {count} reclaimable files ({bytes}). {protected} protected files will not be deleted.
files.deleteConflict: This file changed since it was loaded. The library was refreshed; review the current state and try again.
files.deleteNotFound: This file no longer exists. The library and storage summary were refreshed.
files.deleteProtected: This file is retained or protected by an active reference and cannot be deleted. The library was refreshed.
files.libraryHint: Durable artifacts, evidence, and files shared with Agent runs.
files.empty: No files match the current filters. Try another file type, app, or retention state.

conversation.placeholder: Ask Agent to inspect, diagnose, or explain...
conversation.approvalRequestHint: Allow it, deny it, or deny it with guidance for the next step.
conversation.runFailedHint: This run did not finish. Expand the latest tool records to inspect the failure, fix it, and retry.
conversation.runInterruptedHint: Execution stopped at a safe boundary. Some operations may already have completed; check the current state before continuing.
conversation.runCancelledHint: This run has stopped. You can send a new message to start again.

runIssue.providerRateLimited: The model provider returned a rate-limit / too-many-requests response and automatic retries did not recover.
runIssue.providerUnauthorized: The model provider rejected authentication. Check the current provider credentials.
runIssue.providerForbidden: The model provider denied this account or model access.
runIssue.providerUnavailable: The model provider gateway or upstream service is temporarily unavailable.
runIssue.modelNotFound: The current provider cannot find this model, or the model is no longer available.
runIssue.providerConfigurationStale: The provider configuration frozen into this run is stale. Resend with the current configuration.
runIssue.resourceQuarantined: The target resource is quarantined after an earlier mutation with an unknown outcome. Verify and reconcile it first.
runIssue.reconciliationRequired: An earlier mutation still requires reconciliation, so the new mutation did not continue.
runIssue.leaseConflict: Another operation currently holds the target resource, so a write lease could not be acquired.
runIssue.leaseLost: The resource lease was lost during execution; the Host stopped further mutation to avoid unknown side effects.

conversation.emptyTitle: What would you like to work on?

conversation.clarificationTextHint: Type your answer in the composer below.

commands.attachmentsUnsupported: Slash commands do not accept file attachments. Remove the attachments and try again.

commands.requiresActiveRun: This command requires an active Run.
commands.goalEmpty: No explicit goal has been set for this Run.
commands.planEmpty: The durable plan currently has no items.
commands.queueMoved: Moved pending input from position {from} to {to}.
commands.queueReorderTooLarge: The pending queue is larger than the command view. Reduce it before reordering by position.
commands.interruptSubmitted: The interrupt input was durably appended to the streaming Root model. The current model step is being superseded and rescheduled at a safe boundary.
commands.stopSubmitted: Cancellation was requested for the active Run.
commands.helpGoal: Show the current durable goal, or set a new goal.
commands.helpQueue: Inspect, remove, or reorder durable pending user inputs by position.

commands.genericFailure: The command could not be applied.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.checkpointHint: Facts only: active leases, tokens, containers, and processes are never saved.
tasks.deleteRunHint: Remove this terminal Run from Agent history. This cannot be undone.

attention.approval: This run is waiting for your approval.
attention.budget: This run is paused until its budget is increased.

workspaceRuntime.title: Workspace dev environment
workspaceRuntime.description: One Workspace keeps stable project files while each runtime generation composes Node, Python, Go, and Runner Plugin versions.
workspaceRuntime.toolVersionsHint: Optional tools are mounted by version from the shared read-only Tool Store. Different Workspaces can use different versions.
workspaceRuntime.workspaceToolVersionsHint: Switching a version recreates only this Workspace runtime generation; project files and other Workspaces are unchanged.
workspaceRuntime.versionSwitchUnknown: Workspace tool version switch outcome is unknown and must be reconciled before continuing.
workspaceRuntime.runnerPluginsHint: Targets are explicit and frozen into the Workspace profile. Plugins do not create Docker containers.
workspaceRuntime.noRunnerPlugins: No enabled installed Plugin exposes a Runner target.
workspaceRuntime.selectArtifact: Choose a ready Artifact from this App
workspaceRuntime.oneWorkspacePerRuntime: A runtime owns at most one active Workspace. Delete it before creating a replacement.
workspaceRuntime.reconciliationRequired: A Workspace command has an unknown outcome. Verify it before sending another mutation.
workspaceRuntime.reconciliationPending: The Workspace command outcome is still unknown. The original mutation was not retried.
workspaceRuntime.localTerminalHint: Open a direct PTY terminal for this Workspace generation.
workspaceRuntime.browserTargetHint: When selected, the target configuration is frozen into this Workspace generation.
workspaceRuntime.acpProfilesHint: Select ACP workspace profiles that may start inside this Workspace generation.

subagents.description: Public collaboration state only. Private child prompts and model context are not shown here.
subagents.empty: No child delegations for this run.
subagents.noMessages: No public messages for this child.

approvals.feedbackLabel: Tell the AI how to adjust

ui.reasoningDragHint: Drag the slider or choose a level. A new run freezes the selection.
ui.reasoningLocked: This run has frozen its reasoning effort.
ui.toolOutput: Tool returned a result. Expand to view output.
ui.promptExplain: Explain how the current environment works
ui.promptDiagnose: Check available connections, read only, without changes
